notes.title: DarK Years Update #1
notes.notes:
Problems fixed and Improvements Listed below : 
 
Major :

1-	The safe puzzle quit system fixed , didn’t restart the game anymore .
2- Fixed crash problem during first level.
3- People of AI system improved for problems like running into walls
4- Face motion of amir after Talk didn’t go weird any more.
5- Car navigation system improved. No more two slow after starting the car and to fast speed after moving just one stable speed.
6- Foot step sound synced more precisely with character movements
7- Run Animation movement of Afshar and amir begin exactly with holding the shift key (no more delay)
8- Fixing collider of afshar in some level that caused him to partially go to the walls
9- Spelling problems fixed and removed and all Persian subtitle fixed.
10- Mouse cursor locked and hided always during gameplay 
11- Y Invert of mouse added
12- Stairs in two levels fixed 


Minor :
1-green bar removed from some cutscenes
2-grafiti on the wall of first cutscene is in English now
2-motion blur removed from first level that caused problem
3- Detective clips through the couch a lot during home cutscene.fixed
4-- Amir didnt spawn in the air & fall after prison level.
5-Mini map lines now are more precise with Level environments
6- The hotel attendant changed to proper model
Many other minor fixes or polish things in sound effects , collision , etc.
